definitions.explanation: The upper part of the body containing the brain, eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧です。
{頭|あたま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}います→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
{頭|あたま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぶつけました→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頭|あたま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦なでました→撫でる：04411_naderu⟧。

⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{頭|あたま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}くて→痛い：01108_itai⟧、⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なりません→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My head has been hurting since yesterday, and even though I took medicine, it still hasn't gotten better.

examples.notes: {頭|あたま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ = smart, intelligent

examples.english: Please use your brain and think.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{頭|あたま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧です。

examples.notes: Figurative use: {頭|あたま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧ can mean mental stress

examples.english: That person is smart, so they understand everything quickly. You don't need to explain things to them.

notes:
{頭|あたま} refers to the head (body part) and also the mind/intelligence.

PHYSICAL EXPRESSIONS:
- {頭|あたま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: to have a headache
- {頭|あたま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧: to wash one's head/hair
- {頭|あたま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぶつける→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧: to bump one's head
- {頭|あたま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to bow (one's head)

INTELLIGENCE EXPRESSIONS:
- {頭|あたま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to be smart
- {頭|あたま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: to not be smart
- {頭|あたま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use one's brain
- {頭|あたま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to memorize, to sink in

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {頭|あたま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{固|かた}い→固い：12090_katai⟧: stubborn, inflexible
- {頭|あたま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: mind goes blank
- {頭|あたま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{離|はな}れない→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧: can't get out of one's head
